scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:ui
scripts.app:dev: npm run build:electron && DAWN_DEV_SERVER=http://localhost:5273 electron dist/electron/main.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --grep-invert "内核会话|解释器路径" && playwright test e2e/kernel-session.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:only: playwright test --grep-invert "内核会话|解释器路径"
scripts.test:e2e:visual: npm run build && playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:visual:update: npm run build && playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots=all
